data.one_liner: Detects and highlights links in text using platform native APIs.
data.what_it_does: A Flutter plugin that uses NSDataDetector on iOS and TextClassifier on Android to automatically find and classify links in plain text (such as addresses, phone numbers, emails, dates/times, and URLs). It provides custom widgets like SmartText to render these links with custom configurations.
use_when: You need to automatically linkify addresses, phone numbers, emails, dates, and URLs in plain text.
You want native link detection performance via NSDataDetector and TextClassifier.
avoid_when: You need dateTime support on Android (not supported).
You need address support on Android 8.1 (API 27) and below.
strengths: Supports customizable text styles and click handlers for each link type.
Provides both SmartText and SmartSelectableText widgets.
weaknesses: Some features like DateTime are unsupported on Android.
data.setup_notes: Requires minimum iOS 13.0 and Android SDK 19+.
